verdict.summary_en: Framework Supply Agreement PC-0029-2023 between Soony Interactive GmbH and Guangzhou PackRight Packaging Co., Ltd., effective 2023-09-01, expiring 2027-08-31. It sets FOB Yantian delivery, CNY prices fixed per calendar year, NET30 payment, and a late-delivery penalty of 0.5% per commenced week capped at 5%. Annex A gives prices, MOQs and lead times for four parts. Annex B names one sub-supplier. Annex C maps Soony part numbers to supplier part numbers. The signature line names Jonas Lindqvist (CPO) for Soony and Lin Hui for the Supplier. No handwritten corrections were found.
red_flags: Contract expires 2027-08-31 unless extended in writing.

CMP-MAG-005 has no separate price: it is included in the CMP-GAM-007 price. The magnets come from a single sub-supplier, Jiangxi RareMag, and rare-earth export restrictions count as force majeure under §8.
Supplier must notify Soony within 48 hours of force majeure, and a sub-supplier change needs 90 days' notice and Soony's written approval.
Prices are fixed per calendar year only. The document does not say how prices are set for later years.
observations: PDF is machine-typeset text across 3 pages. No handwriting, stamps or strike-throughs were seen.
Signature line is printed text only: 'Munich, 2023-09-01 · for Soony: Jonas Lindqvist, CPO · for Supplier: Lin Hui'. No visible handwritten signatures.
The first attempt to render the PDF pages failed because pdftoppm is not installed. The file was then read without the pages parameter and all 3 pages were returned.
In Annex A the CMP-MAG-005 price cell wraps across lines ('included in C / MP-GAM-007'). I read it as 'included in CMP-GAM-007'.
